name: industry-research-framework
description:
Structures deep industry research covering key players, business models, trends,
job market dynamics, and entry points. Produces a comprehensive research brief
document for career decision-making.
Use when the user wants to research an industry before a career move, understand
a new market for job targeting, or conduct due diligence on an industry they are
considering entering.
Do NOT use for company-specific research before an interview (use company-research-guide),
competitive analysis for business strategy (use competitive-analysis), or market
research for a product (use market-research skills).
